name: JoAi: Store Address

description.en: Create or update a billing or shipping address. Pass contact for a CRM contact billing address, team for team billing (upgrade flow), or neither for the authenticated user's own address.

bot: Use when saving a billing or shipping address. For a CRM contact invoice/billing address, pass contact (hashid from contact-find-or-create / contact-list) plus name, country, and optional addressOne/city/zipCode/vatId — the address is stored as billing on that contact. For user-create → upgrade-link flow, pass type=billing, team=personalTeamSlug, and optional vatId. Do not pass contact and team together.

inputs.name: Country
inputs.bot: Convert the country to the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code before submitting.

inputs.name: Type
inputs.bot: Ignored when contact or team is set (those always store a billing/invoice address). Otherwise defaults to shipping.

inputs.name: Contact

description.en: Contact hashid when storing a CRM contact billing address

inputs.bot: Pass the contact hashid to upsert that contact's invoice/billing address (used on orders and invoices). Resolve via contact-find-or-create or contact-list first.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug when storing a team billing address

inputs.bot: Required for team billing in the user-create → address-store → upgrade-link flow. Use personalTeamSlug from user-create. Do not use together with contact. Do not pass the current workspace team here unless you intend to set that team's billing address.
